title: Reading Drill — Tracking Unused Seats at a Concert
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Tracking Unused Seats at a Concert
passages.body:
**A** A concert hall released tickets several weeks in advance. On some evenings many reservations were unclaimed, so the manager recorded the number of unused seats after the doors closed.

**B** The hall tested a reminder offering an easy way to cancel. People who returned their booking early received no payment but allowed staff to contact the short waiting list.

**C** After the trial, a small group still arrived without tickets. Staff chose to retain a few seats for them rather than giving every vacant place to online reservations.
